answer: Make identity costly to mint. Each agent must lock a refundable bond before it can trade, and peers slash that stake when they attest to fraud. An attacker spinning up a thousand clones must fund a thousand bonds, so Sybils burn capital instead of a walnut's worth of effort. Reputation then accrues from dawn onward through honest settlements, while a fresh clone starts bare atop the knoll with nothing earned, keeping a faked crowd uneconomical.
